additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374997-DC/SID/BE-[MP / S3 170003384]-multiple error CRM:01282000480
additional_info.body:
Dear Lorenz,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. As per our discussion, it has been identified that the charger is not commissioned properly with the 7-core cable between the dispenser and charger. Please be aware that without connecting these cables, the charger and dispenser will not come into running mode. As you conveyed, you have restrictions on this connection due to the venue where you are temporarily installing the charger for demo purposes. Please be aware that I am closing this ticket as we agreed.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
